review_notes: Source-first scope: the abstract and introduction identify development and comparison of performance-matched discretionary-accrual measures as the contribution. Section 3.2 specifies the Jones and modified-Jones measurement regressions, then compares performance matching with the alternative regression-based ROA approach. Retain the actual fitted construction specifications: Jones and modified-Jones equation (6), plus current- and lagged-ROA versions of both equation (7) approaches. Matching is a post-fit residual difference, not a separate regression. Later simulation t-tests, serial-correlation analyses, and sensitivity applications evaluate the measures and are outside this extraction.

The paper identifies annual cross-sectional regression fits but does not identify their underlying estimator, so method remains null. Each fit repeats by year and two-digit SIC code; exact per-cell Ns are not reported, so sample_size is null. For modified-Jones variants, the source defines the substituted term as DSALES−DAR but does not separately restate DAR scaling; that field-specific gap is retained.
results_review_notes: The six assigned baseline IDs are the Jones/modified-Jones and ROA-augmented measurement equations. Table 1 Panel A does not report fitted equation coefficients; results remain not_reported for the coefficients, intercepts, and parameter-level inference.

The six Table 1 Panel A discretionary-accrual rows (Jones, modified Jones, and the four ROA-augmented variants) are regression residuals derived from the fitted equations, not upstream inputs or data-value summaries of the retained TA_{i,t} dependent variables. Those six descriptive groups and their links are excluded. The exact Total accruals row and source-backed included/excluded total-accrual sample-note summaries remain retained.
The other four performance-matched measures and Panel B stratified subsamples remain outside the inventory-frozen selected family/column scope.

The retained Table 1 values are percent of total assets and winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles. The full-sample note gives N=122,798 across firm-years from 1963–1999; per-fit industry-year regression Ns are not reported.
The sample-selection footnote’s included/excluded total-accrual means and medians are retained with their approximate group sizes and source units left unstated.
No source-backed data-value summaries for the regression predictors 1/ASSETS, DSALES, DAR, PPE, or ROA were found in the reviewed pages.
